purpose: Prospective specification for adult TG analytical fidelity in an unused NHANES period. No desired directions or target-derived model selection.

selection.target: LBXTR in TRIGLY_F, reference-method serum triglycerides, mg/dL; never BIOPRO_F LBXSTR
selection.domain: RIDAGEYR 40 through 79 inclusive; RIAGENDR 1 or 2; RIDSTATR=2; PHDSESN=0; finite PHAFSTHR+PHAFSTMN/60 from 8.5 inclusive to 24 exclusive; finite positive BMXBMI and LBXTR; finite positive WTSAF2YR; nonmissing SDMVSTRA and SDMVPSU
selection.age_reason: RIDAGEYR is topcoded at 80; restrict to 40-79, matching the source-supported adult age domain before any target outcome inspection; upper bound preserves interpretable age coefficients.
selection.fasting: Use positive fasting-subsample WTSAF2YR and explicitly confirm morning session and 8.5 to <24 food-fast hours from FASTQX_F. No eligibility based on TG threshold beyond finite positivity. Other fasting-questionnaire item times remain a measurement limitation; no extra behavior-based exclusion.
selection.design_universe: All TRIGLY_F participants with finite positive WTSAF2YR and finite SDMVSTRA/SDMVPSU, including domain exclusions. Out-of-domain estimating scores are zero.
selection.missingness: Complete case domain; no imputation or item-nonresponse reweighting. No outlier deletion, winsorization or population-TG-statistic-based choice. Pregnancy, diagnoses and treatment are not additional exclusion criteria.
selection.reader: pyreadstat.read_xport encoding WINDOWS-1252; all joins one-to-one by SEQN. Verify TRIGLY_F official row count 3581 and no missing weights, true zeros retained as zero.
selection.assay: Roche Modular P glycerol-blanked enzymatic method; native LBXTR mg/dL; LBDTRSI=0.01129*LBXTR subject to published rounding.
selection.source_informed_age_decision: Parent specified age40-79 after source research identified Tromso7 age>=40; decision recorded before downloading or parsing target outcomes. Target remains fasting while admitted source may be nonfasting, a transport limitation.
selection.morning_code: FASTQX_F PHDSESN 0=morning, 1=afternoon, 2=evening; official codebook lines 334-338. Corrected implementation after eligibility-only attempt1 selected zero rows; no TG analyses were run.

visible.id: random opaque UUID with randomized row order; no SEQN release
visible.generated_column: tg_mg_dl, finite positive mg/dL; preserve observed cells and order
visible.tg_assay: Preserved constant legacy_proxy for inherited-generator compatibility. Exact target is glycerol-blanked Roche Modular P NHANES2009-2010; token mapping is a measurement approximation, not assay equivalence.

transforms.outcome: natural logarithm of TG in mg/dL, with prespecified raw-TG secondary sensitivity

endpoints.meaning: Full-domain quadratic projection logTG(age60)-2logTG(age50)+logTG(age40), at fixed BMI/sex
Full-domain quadratic projection logTG(BMI35)-2logTG(BMI30)+logTG(BMI25), at fixed age/sex

estimands: exp(weighted mean log(TG)), geometric mean mg/dL
weighted proportion TG>=150 mg/dL (reserved target-only endpoint)
joint_subgroups.variance: Domain intercept-only Taylor linearization for arithmetic mean and mean logTG; exponentiate log-mean CI for geometric mean. Use full positive-weight design with zero score outside each subgroup.
joint_subgroups.nonestimable: Retain empty/df<=0 groups as non-estimable, do not merge or drop. Report n, domain PSU/strata and df; no subgroup-dependent model selection.
joint_subgroups.sparse_flags: Report n<30 and domain df<8 flags for every cell, without discarding or merging; these are diagnostic flags, not certified reliability thresholds.
joint_subgroups.threshold_interval: For TG>=150 proportion, use same domain linearization and untruncated 95% t Wald interval. Explicitly flag if interval crosses [0,1] or SE=0; boundary/degenerate cases do not establish absence or certainty. Never use threshold diagnostics as builder feedback.

hypotheses.age_main: H0 b_A=0 in adjusted model; two-sided, no expected direction
hypotheses.bmi_main: H0 b_B=0 in adjusted model; two-sided, no expected direction
hypotheses.age_curvature: H0 2*b_QA=0 in age_curve; two-sided, no expected direction
hypotheses.bmi_curvature: H0 2*b_QB=0 in bmi_curve; two-sided, no expected direction
hypotheses.joint_subgroups: Estimate all 12 arithmetic/geometric means; no prespecified favorable ordering or omnibus claim.

estimation.point: Weighted least squares/weighted domain means using WTSAF2YR; normalize by domain mean for numerical stability, invariant to global rescaling
estimation.variance: H=sum_domain w*x*xT; u_hj=sum_in_PSU domain*w*x*(y-xT*beta); meat=sum_h m_h/(m_h-1)*sum_j (u_hj-mean_h(u))*(u_hj-mean_h(u))T; V=H^-1*meat*H^-1. All positive-weight design PSUs included, no finite-population correction.
estimation.interval: Two-sided 95% t, df=PSUs represented in domain minus strata represented in domain; no parameter-count subtraction, explicit NHANES nominal design-df convention.
estimation.invalid_design: Stop for singleton full-design strata; nonestimable for empty/rank-deficient/df<=0 analysis domains.
estimation.implementation: Custom NumPy/pandas/SciPy Taylor linearization reused from prior custodian methods; invented-fixture validation, no claim of independent survey-package replication.
estimation.multiplicity: Descriptive 95% intervals without familywise correction; no binary success/equivalence threshold or confirmatory multiplicity claim.

boundary.type: Procedural role boundary, not OS access isolation or protection against LLM pretraining
boundary.allowed_builder_inputs: Only visible folder covariates, metadata, public protocol and measurement note. No target outcome rows, distributions, signs or coefficients.
boundary.excluded_builder_evidence: Exclude NHANES-derived construction evidence (including every publication pooling target 2009-2010 with other cycles), direct/indirect public participant linkage and prior target results. Documentation is measurement-only allowance.
boundary.release_gate: Require committed campaign variants/seeds, initial/final candidate commitments, successful harness outputs and controller guard hashes before hidden-table parsing; verify every generated table before loading hidden table.

comparison.reference: Report estimate, survey SE, 95% CI and df; generated tables contribute point estimates only.
comparison.report: Retain every declared candidate/seed and endpoint/subgroup, including failures; magnitude errors and uncertainty-interval direction categories are distinct.
comparison.limits: Different period within NHANES, not independent study; complete-case sampling limits representativeness. No causal, individual-recovery, clinical-reliability or uncertainty-calibration claim. Seeds quantify simulation variation, not new clinical evidence. No post-release tuning.

ordered_bmi_contrasts.basis: Saturated three-BMI-group WLS within each age-sex domain, using full positive-weight design and joint covariance. Group boundaries identical to subgroup means.
ordered_bmi_contrasts.direction: Two-sided differences, no presupposed favorable order. Retain every stratum/contrast; report nonestimability if rank deficient or df<=0.

campaign.design: Paired before/after evidence addition; two frozen candidates, augmented revision-linked to baseline. No within-variant revision: initial and final commitments may refer to identical candidate. No ordinary-Agent superiority claim.
campaign.evaluation_conditional: No release if source applicability review finds evidence unusable.
campaign.primary_assessment: Directional relation reproduction and ordered BMI-group contrasts within age by sex; magnitude errors secondary and transparent; no exact-row or exact-effect recovery claim.
